_readme: Sylvia's content pack. Anything added here ships with the app and works offline. Students cannot delete it. Upload a new content.json and change VERSION in sw.js to update phones.

resources.title: How to use ScrubUp for Pharmacology
resources.text:
1. Read the drug profile.
2. Swipe the bite-size cards.
3. Do a past-paper test.
4. Revise the drugs it tells you to.
